And for this reason he did not allow us to let us go, and he would not be punished in his heart, but from hour to hour, and above, because he had already done so, that he had already done so:

yad-ephraim/3:_.he: בט"ז ס"ק ט'. הקשה הרא"ש דהא אין מערבין כו' ר"ל דשם במשנה איתא לשבות שביתת הרשות ופירש"י שמערב עירובי תחומין:
yad-ephraim/3:_.en: In the T-shirt. Hashem’s promise is that Hashem’s people are not in charge of Hashem’s presence, and Hashem’s promise is that they are in heaven
